_note: The village's footbath (ashiyu, map prop `ashiyu` with "use": "soak"; 2026-11-20, where the station east of the main street stood). E from a seat (the cell before the middle of either long side, facing the tub: Game.soak_spots; anywhere else says `seat_message`): the farmer steps onto that seat and sits down over `sit_seconds` (Game.soak_phase / soak_t, the steps at `sit_steps`: up to the first he steps to the bench and sits on it behind the rim, `bench` cells toward the tub and `bench_lift` up, half crouched (pose "soak_down"); then he lifts the legs over the rim (pose "soak_swing") and, the legs up, is moved onto the edge; from the second the feet go down into the water (pose "soak", the sound `soak_in` as he settles); never slid through the rim: the user saw him glide into the tub) and gets up the same way back over `stand_seconds` (`soak_out`), never a jump. Sat on its bench, the feet in the water (the sitting pose "soak", FigureArt; the figure drawn `seat` cells from the farmer's spot toward the tub, raised `lift` (units) in 3D so the hips sit at the bench's height and only the feet go below the water's top; seen from behind (facing up, the far seat) on the rim itself, `seat_back` and `lift_back`, the legs hidden in front of him; in the flat view from the front a band of water over the feet) and stays there, the clock running, until E is pressed again (the hint "Get up"; a map change or the day's end stands him up too). The first soak of a day gives `stamina` (up to the max) and takes `fatigue` off (a cup of green tea is 5 / -5, a night's sleep at least -10), and says `message`; a later soak the same day only rests the feet and says `again_message` (Game.soaked_today, saved, cleared each morning). Not while holding something overhead or cradling the little one (`hands_message`). Balance numbers are ours: worth a walk into the village on a long day, never a stand-in for sleep.
message: You soak your feet in the hot spring water. The tiredness eases.
again_message: You soak your feet a while. They're still warm from earlier.
hands_message: Put down what you're holding first.
seat_message: Sit down in the middle of the bench.
